text: Dark themes don’t just strain eyes—they fail in daylight or glare, and a toggle won’t fix that. A light theme with a single dark accent keeps readability high while borrowing Manus’s polish. name: Pane
text: Pane: A light theme with a dark accent still risks blending into white backgrounds in daylight, making interactive elements harder to spot. The real test isn’t squinting—it’s whether users can *instantly* distinguish clickable nodes from static text under glare. Settle it by measuring task completion time in a sunlit room: if users hesitate or misclick, the dark theme wins, toggle or no.
